summary: A Yes vote requires voter approval before the City of Los Altos sells or develops ten specified downtown parking plazas.

housing.text: A Yes vote would prohibit the City from selling, leasing, conveying, or declaring the ten Downtown Parking Plazas as surplus without voter approval, with an exception for developing two plazas for affordable housing.
housing.quote: prohibits the City of Los Altos from selling, leasing, conveying, or declaring as surplus land the ten City-owned Downtown Parking Plazas for any reason

housing.text: A No vote would leave the existing rules governing the sale, lease, conveyance, surplus designation, and redevelopment of the ten Downtown Parking Plazas unchanged.
housing.quote: prohibits the City of Los Altos from selling, leasing, conveying, or declaring as surplus land the ten City-owned Downtown Parking Plazas for any reason
